title: Former Plaud exec raises $26M for AI app that listens to you in the background
slides: A former Plaud exec raised $26M for an AI that listens.
The app runs in the background, always recording.
But its real trick is knowing when to ignore you.
You'll get automatic notes without lifting a finger.
Ask: would you wear a mic all day for that?
thread_text:
1. The $26M Always-On Mic

A former Plaud exec just raised $26M for an AI that listens in the background all day. It records everything by default.

2. Recording Is Not the Feature

Anyone can hit record. This app's real trick is knowing when to ignore you — filtering out the noise and only keeping what matters.

3. Notes Without Lifting a Finger

You get automatic summaries and action items without touching your phone. No start, no stop, no editing.

4. Would You Wear It?

The catch: you'd need to wear a mic all day. Always on, always listening. That's a big ask for most people.

5. Test the Trade-Off This Week

Try recording one meeting on your phone and writing notes manually. Compare the time. Does the AI really save you, or just shift the work?
